text_block_list.text:
"Somehow, it feels like Mejiro Ardan isn't 
quite in top form today..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I've had a bit of a 
headache since this morning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no problem. Pain of this 
degree is... ngh.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. I'll see how 
it goes for a bit and then get back to 
training.

Mejiro Ardan forced a smile, but she was 
plagued by a headache for a while 
afterward.
